subject: general
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

All engineers are skilled. No unskilled person is allowed.

Conclusions:

I. All engineers are allowed.

II. No skilled person is unskilled.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2330c1d5fe42acdaf31d399a1d170a500d5aefd268c360f415c2275acca6f08.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All engineers are allowed → Follow (As all engineers are skilled and only skilled person is allowed. so, all engineers are allowed).

II. No skilled person is unskilled → Follow (A person cannot be both skilled and unskilled at the same time. Hence skilled and unskilled are mutually exclusive categories).

Thus, both I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3”.
